CustomField.description: Flags when the student’s Date of Birth does not meet age requirements for the grade applying to. • PK: Student must turn 4 by December 31 of the enrollment year • K/TK: Student must turn 5 by December 31 of the enrollment year • Grades 1–12: integer age at the term start date must be within [grade+5, grade+6] (e.g. 7th = 12–13, 8th = 13–14) Returns TRUE if the DOB falls outside the required age range.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Flags when the student’s Date of Birth does not meet requirements.
CustomField.label: Age Inconsistency Flag
